field_note: Bridge blocked after heavy flooding. Around 40 people isolated near the school. No clean water since yesterday.
Village school shelter has 75 people including families with children. Need blankets, drinking water, and registration support.
Road partially covered by mud and rocks after landslide. One bus route blocked. No injuries reported yet.
Smoke visible near west village edge. Two elderly residents report breathing difficulty. Need evacuation guidance.
Clinic has no insulin refrigeration after power failure. 18 patients registered. Backup generator not working.
Remote settlement reports no safe drinking water for two days. Around 120 people. Road passable by motorcycle only.
Storm damaged rural school roof. Classes suspended. No injuries. Need safety inspection and temporary learning space.
Radio operator reports isolated neighborhood after flood. Unknown number of people, no photo available.
